scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:html
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && terser web/app.js --compress --mangle --output dist/app.js && cleancss web/styles.css -o dist/styles.css && html-minifier-terser web/index.html --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true --output dist/index.html
